newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Tian An China 1996 net down 64.75 pct.
newsitem.headline: Tian An China 1996 net down 64.75 pct.

text.p: Company name Tian An China Investments Co Ltd
NOTE - Tian An China engages in hotel and property investment in China.

Net is after exceptional items of HK$1.62 million loss on provision for permanent diminution in value of investment, HK$3.42 million loss on provision for doubtful recovery of amount due from an associated company, HK$9.4 million loss on provision for permanent diminution in value of investment, HK$3.8 million loss on provision for doubtful recovery of amount due from as associated company and gain of HK$4.24 million on disposal of investment properties.
Comparison figures had been adjusted to conform with new accounting policy regarding recognition of income from sale of development properties.
Total dividend for year is one H.K. cent vs two cents.
